posts.cooked:
Ah, I see. In my case, an Infected Fixer had bit himself for 4 (Inspiring Presence, Galvanize, Grease Monkey (I think)), and then used the second hit to hit Plague Rat for 8.

It also seems as if Jack Handle trumps Infection attack, since it causes him to do "that damage" to all non-hero targets whenever he would do damage. It happened in one of my games yesterday. Fixer went to do himself 1 Irreducible, but instead dealt 1 Irreducible to all non-heroes thanks to Jack Handle.

There's all sorts of odd effects with Fixer that I'm learning from the app. When I've played before, I just played that Fixer dealt himself the 1 damage from Infection and THEN did the damage to all non-hero targets.
